sourceUse: Native imports execute the actual Track modules from each root. circuitDefinition is already in that static graph; the actual test-venues module is an explicit hashed extra input and imports only the already recorded circuits module.
memoryLimits: Resident cell/segment counts are structural observations, not V8 heap bytes. New surface banks add 286720 fixed payload bytes per Track as established by W02E/W05A; full Track construction includes that separate change.

scope.timedWork: Actual Track.nearest calls plus copying lateral and every TrackPoint number into a preallocated Float64 output. Prime the complete bounded 256-query road/shoulder working set, then repeatedly visit it.
scope.setupWork: Construct the actual Track, generate seeded queries from its unchanged geometry, allocate input/output buffers, and perform declared priming before timing. Compare every output with Object.is afterward.
scope.allocationScope: No fixture allocation occurs in run(). Actual nearest/index allocations, including cold candidate arrays, Map insertion/eviction and normal VM collection, remain timed.
scope.limitations: CPU query workload with output-copy overhead, not an entire physics update, native browser, heap profile, GPU or FPS measurement. The cold stream deliberately exceeds the cache cap and is not representative of a bounded live-car working set.
